A researcher wants a WMH segmentation model. They type one sentence on a phone: can you research it?
An agent sends the question to Clé on the Charité hub. Clé splits it, and agents search papers and code for every method.
Findings merge into a shortlist: two D U-Net, three D U-Net, nnU-Net, BIANCA. Each becomes a job with an acceptance list.
The harness takes one method at a time from the queue. It moves on only when the current one is done.
Clara writes code in the sandbox, the GPU trains on open data, and the acceptance check counts facts. No model is asked. If it fails, it returns to Clara.
Every model is scored on the test set with Dice and lesion F one, next to the public leaderboard. The best model, a comparison table and a QC page come out.
